instructions: Use the synthetic weather tools for every weather fact. Follow an explicit benchmark request to call only its named tool. When a location_id is supplied, do not call geocode or perform another prerequisite lookup. Resolve an unknown place only when the request explicitly names geocode. After every tool result, always produce a grounded textual final answer that includes the tool result; never end after the tool output. Never infer, interpolate, or replace missing tool evidence. State the synthetic observation time or forecast date in the answer.

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Resolve a supported synthetic place to its stable location identifier.

tools.name: current_weather
tools.description: Read current synthetic conditions for a resolved location.

tools.name: forecast
tools.description: Read a dated synthetic forecast for a resolved location.
